inputAdapters.allowed: Normalize typed search text through Language Kernel synonyms before Search Kernel ranking.
只能作为上游 projection builder 的来源说明，不得作为 SearchKernelService 直接查询输入。
inputAdapters.forbidden: Search Kernel 不得直接读取 OperationsReadStore.SearchOperations 或 runtime fact；必须消费 SearchIndexRecord、OamObjectEnvelope、LensReadModel 或 generated read model。

privacyRules: Do not show another user's raw query text.
Store and rank by canonical intent id when possible.
Recommendations must pass Search Kernel permission policy and Admission Kernel visibility.
Recommendations must never grant confirmAllowed or productionAllowed.

projectionAdapters.name: ProjectionWorkspaceSearchAdapter
projectionAdapters.allowed: May provide current workspace-card projection results only as read-side input to SearchKernelService.
projectionAdapters.forbidden: Must not bypass Language Kernel synonyms, permission policy, Admission Kernel, or Operations Runtime fact ownership.

projectionAdapters.name: searchIntentHub
projectionAdapters.allowed: May adapt current backend SearchResult view models to mobile navigation.
projectionAdapters.forbidden: Must not decide business production permission or business-line maturity.

runtimeAdapters.name: OperationsReadStore.SearchOperations
runtimeAdapters.allowed: May feed tenant-scoped confirmed operation events into an authorized projection builder that emits SearchIndexRecord.
runtimeAdapters.forbidden: Must not be queried directly by SearchKernelService and must not replace SearchIndexRecord, OamObjectEnvelope, LensReadModel, or generated read model inputs.

invariants: Every SearchResult includes an admission object.
Every SearchResult includes permission, lineage, freshness, ranking, businessContext, availableActions, gateResult, traceRefs, and sourceRefs.
SearchResult.availableActions may only contain read-only navigation or learning actions with writeBusinessFact=false.
workspaceCardProjection may appear only as a source type, adapter name, or sourceRefs value; the external resultType is workspaceCardCompatibility.
gateResult may appear as a read-only SearchResult.
Blocked business lines cannot be made executable by search ranking.
Search uses Language Kernel synonyms and domain terms.
Contains-only matching is allowed only inside registered projection adapters.
Search visibility is not confirm permission.
Business anchors such as names, phones, room labels, and bed labels are display/search-only and must not become fact owners.
SearchKernelService must not directly query OperationsReadStore.SearchOperations.
OperationsReadStore.SearchOperations may only feed an upstream projection builder.
Search / Lens / Projection consume generated read models and read envelopes only.
